jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Ira School District, a town school district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member town: Ira). The district is non-operating (PreK-12 tuition, K-12 choice).
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site; carries the Ira district budget pages).

sources.note: Ira School District: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a) (no section 423(b) expansion in any town record; Ira Town Plan: the School Board "is comprised of three people"). The district is non-operating -- it tuitions all grades PreK-12 with K-12 school choice (Ira School Board Report, Town of Ira 2022 Annual Report). 16 V.S.A. section 423(a): each town school district has three directors, one elected by ballot at each annual meeting for a three-year term. No section 423(b) expansion appears in any town record: every Town of Ira officers list from 2022 through 2025 carries exactly three School Director rows.

Town of Ira Town Clerk page (official), hosting the town officers lists and election results: "Town Officers, As of March 2025 Election" (School Directors: Philip Lapp, elected March 2025 to the balance of the 2023 term ending 2026; Sarah Meling, "November 2024, 3 Year, 2027"; Jeff Barden, elected March 2025, ends 2028) and the "2026 Town & School Election Results" (School Director, 3-year term: Philip Lapp -- re-elected March 2026, term to 2029). The district is non-operating (PreK-12 tuition / K-12 choice), per the Ira School Board Report in the Town of Ira 2022 Annual Report.

directors.name: Philip Lapp
directors.note: First seated March 2025, elected to the remaining year of the 3-year term that had stood vacant since March 2023 (the town officers lists show the seat "Vacant" in 2023 and 2024); re-elected March 2026 to a full 3-year term.

directors.name: Sara Meling
directors.note: Elected at the November 5, 2024 special election for the remaining two years of the 3-year term (March 2024 officers list footnote). Name flag: the contemporaneous March 2024 list spells her "Sara Meling"; the March 2025 officers list spells "Sarah Meling." Minted as Sara per the contemporaneous document; the certified return of the November 5, 2024 special election would resolve the spelling.

directors.name: Jeff Barden
directors.note: First elected March 2022; re-elected March 2025 to a 3-year term.
